events.name: Garden Rescue
events.description: Five years ago, David and John hoped the team could change their long plot into somewhere suitable for their wedding. Charlie Dimmock goes back to Shoreham-by-Sea in West Sussex to find the formal garden she designed and built has grown into something completely different as the middle section is now a secret garden hidden from view. Inspired by their hard work at keeping the garden, Charlie helps the couple add to it. The presenter also checks in with Kim in Cwmcarn, Monmouthshire, the owner of the steepest garden the team ever built, and a garden in Cosham, Hampshire, that helped one man on the road to recovery

events.description: Alan Titchmarsh heads to Swindon to surprise Lorraine, a retired RAF servicewoman and devoted charity volunteer. Because of a spinal injury, Lorraine struggles with mobility issues and lives with her full-time support team - Leonbergers Poppy and Doris. Poppy is a retired therapy dog and Doris is Lorraine's assistance dog, and helps with chores such as laundry and fetching household items. The team creates a fabulous low-maintenance garden as a calming retreat for both Lorraine and her canine family

In the auction room, a small but perfectly formed painting by one of the world's most famous artists, John Constable, is ready for auction. Silver enthusiast Oliver desperately hopes that a late 19th-century Japanese silver punchbowl will be coming home with him, while auctioneer Michael needs to sell a 1930s Philco radio that props-buyer Bridie and her mother Sara have fallen in love with

event.name: Edwardian Farm
event.description: To mark the half-way point of their sociological experiment, Alex Langlands, Peter Ginn and Ruth Goodman explore a single day in an Edwardian farmer's household. Using a cache of letters from the time found in Morwhellham to research the realities of life, the trio experience typical daily routines, from the usual early morning hair-styling and oral hygiene, to the end-of-the-day trip to the local pub

event.name: Our Dream Farm with Matt Baker
event.description: The three finalists explore the wider Wallington Estate and meet other farm tenants to demonstrate how well they might fit into the local rural community. They get to work on three very different farms and learn more about what life is like as a tenant on the historic estate. Back on the farm, they work alongside the National Trust ranger team to extend an old footpath through the fields and past the beaver enclosure to help improve public access on the estate

event.description: Alan Titchmarsh and the team create an elegant tea garden for a charity volunteer in Birmingham who makes cakes for injured members of the services. The garden includes a fully equipped kitchen so she can bake pies and cakes in the fresh air, raised beds for growing fresh ingredients, and a colourful living wall. Plus, Katie Rushworth offers tips on balcony and rooftop gardening
